## Bugs Found and Fixed

| ID | Test | Root Cause | Fix Applied |
|----|------|-----------|-------------|
| BUG-001 | `test_order_unknown_item_returns_404` | `inventory[order.item]` raised an unhandled `KeyError` (HTTP 500) when item was absent | Added `if order.item not in inventory` guard → `HTTPException(404)` |
| BUG-002 | `test_order_negative_quantity_rejected` | `quantity: int` had no lower-bound constraint; negative values were silently accepted | Changed to `quantity: int = Field(..., gt=0)` → Pydantic now returns HTTP 422 |
| BUG-003/004 | `test_order_out_of_stock_returns_400` | Out-of-stock path raised `HTTPException(status_code=500)` — a server error for a client mistake | Changed to `HTTPException(status_code=400)` |
